⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Audio-aligned point events.

Use for decoder resets, ASR finalization, diarization switches, endpoint
commits, barge-in detection, agent state transitions, and latency markers.

Each row stores one or more events using parallel arrays. The row timestamp
can still carry the event on a Rerun timeline; `event_time` records the
source media time so events remain useful for complete audio assets and
exported clips.
